user.title: RoomFlow
user.description:
That's it - nothing to configure here. Time-of-day sources, weekday/weekend, home/away, rooms, devices, buttons and motion are all configured afterward from the RoomFlow card (sidebar) → Settings tab, and apply instantly.

⚠️ Early days: RoomFlow is under active development, expect rough edges and occasional breaking changes between releases.

force_period.name: Force period
force_period.description: Holds a schedule in a period until its own conditions move on to a different period. Re-applies every device right away; motion-controlled devices keep following motion.

schedule_id.name: Schedule
schedule_id.description: Schedule ID. Defaults to the main schedule.

clear_forced_period.name: Clear forced period
clear_forced_period.description: Ends a forced period and re-applies the schedule's own period to every device.

schedule_id.name: Schedule
schedule_id.description: Schedule ID. Defaults to the main schedule.
